title: You pull to a hook ring

steps.text: Once the room has the shared hook, F or RB starts a cable and arm pose immediately. A missed target gives a short flick and sound.
Your tab drives your body along the clear path to the picked slab. The pull, target choice and feedback add no shared operation.
Normal position presence carries the travel. The additional railwayHook field names the ring only while pulling; missing or invalid values mean off.
Your friend draws a cable from your interpolated hand to the known ring and poses that arm. Letting go winds it back; leaving removes it.
